snippet.title: Fragmentary Order — Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
https://fragmentaryorder.com

200 years ago, humanity was able to stand on the brink of darkness, survive and reverse mutual total destruction. The organization that secretly proclaimed itself the Core was able to gather the remnants of everything human and turn the tide of destruction, convincing and uniting the governments of the world.

People began to explore the solar system, defeated famine and war, praising the savior - the Core. By that time, trust in governments had been completely lost and the world had moved to a corporate system of power controlled by Core structures.

Over time, the Core's control began to weaken, and new alliances emerged, deciding that it was their time to rule. Humanity has once again begun to slip back into what nearly destroyed them at the beginning of the twenty-first century.

It's 2251 now. From this moment your journey begins.

#FragmentaryOrder #cor3
